exposure: Time from symptom onset to surgical intervention
outcome: Delay times to essential surgical care
Categorization of delays using the Three Delays Framework
cohort: Patients requiring a Bellwether procedure (emergency caesarean section, open long bone fracture management, or acute abdominal pain requiring surgery) at Timor Leste's national referral hospital over a 2-month period, excluding those whose procedure was >24 hours from initial presentation.
finding: Substantial delays were observed for all three stages (decision to seek care, arrival at a health facility, and receiving appropriate care) of the Three Delays Framework, with the first delay (decision to seek care) being significantly longer than the second (arrival at facility) and third (receiving care) delays.
